brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Two half bases (half-s at 1,0,0 and half-n at -1,0,0) with a drawer on each cut face (drawer:0#-1,0#cut and drawer:0#1,0#cut). Full base at 0,0,0 joins them. check_build: no errors, meshClash clear.

Not verified. This tool checks fit and mesh clearance only, not strength or load ratings, so I cannot confirm the 50 kg capacity. The build has no dedicated book shelf surface or bin; a load test or rated spec is needed.

finish.summary: The build is a three-cell base (full base in the centre, half bases to the east and west) with one drawer on each of the two half bases' cut faces. It passes check_build with no errors and a clear mesh check. The 50 kg book rating cannot be verified with this configurator, and I did not add a book-specific shelf or bin, so that requirement is unmet.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
